---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  select(yearID, teamID, G, HR) |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(yearID) |>
  mutate(home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

shortened_seasons <- c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)

hr_by_season |>
  mutate(shortened = yearID %in% shortened_seasons) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "#cc4c02", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = shortened), size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#cc4c02", "TRUE" = "#2b8cbe"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Regular season", "TRUE" = "Shortened season"),
    name = "Season type"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Runs per Team Game by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs per Team Game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

comparison <- hr_by_season |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
  select(yearID, total_home_runs, total_team_games, home_runs_per_game) |>
  arrange(factor(yearID, levels = c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020))) |>
  rename(
    season = yearID,
    total_home_runs = total_home_runs,
    total_team_games = total_team_games,
    home_runs_per_game = home_runs_per_game
  )

knitr::kable(comparison, digits = 2)
```

# Home runs

This page explores home run trends in Major League Baseball using Lahman data.
